testcase.name: Scenario: Restore a locked view after temporarily hiding its solid: mnt/vininas-projects/MCAD-Scenarios/features/application/model-browser/model-browser.feature:1191:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Restore a locked view after temporarily hiding its solid ✔ Given The MCAD Software has a part containing one visible solid body ✔ And an unlocked copied view is active ✔ When the user chooses Lock from the copied view context menu ✔ And the user chooses All Hidden from the copied view context menu ✔ Then the solid body is hidden in the viewport ✔ And the copied view displays a lock indicator ✔ When the user activates the Primary view ✔ Then the solid body is visible ✔ When the user activates the locked copied view ✔ Then the solid body is visible ✔ And the copied view displays its active and locked indicators
